subject: Quick swap for the delivery?
text:
Hey,

So, I've got a bit of a snag with the delivery on Thursday morning. My seminar got shifted, and if I don't turn up at that exact time, I'm properly toast — the lecturer signs attendance and whatnot. Could we maybe push it to after lunch? Around half past two or three would be dead easy for me, and I'll make sure someone's actually home to take the box rather than leaving it with the neighbours again.

If that won't work, I could grab it from the depot later that week, though I'd rather not have to lug it back through the rain. Anyway, give me a shout when you can, no need to panic. I reckon it's only a minor mix-up anyway. The parcel can wait with you if that helps.

Cheers,
